about: [C13] the tail's gun phase reads the table (6 + 6), and "He warned them." never comes without its warning: the river road kept up with by the good hands' driving, never shot or shunted (C3b: a good follower usually ends at the gate), until he reaches the gate - every 'He warned them.' had "He's nearly at the pier." up 3 s and more before it (after the critic: it comes 4 s from the gate at his speed; it was 1.8 s with him 41 m off) (it used to be hidden under the knock's line, or up for under a second when he came flat out). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/c13_tail_gate.json

steps.eval: (() => { window.__tailFails = []; window.__tries = []; let cur = null, rec = null; window.__pk = (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; return [C.gun.rounds, C.gun.pocket]; })(); setInterval(() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx && G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (!C) return; if (C !== cur) { cur = C; rec = { gateAt: null, why: null, t: null, pk: [C.gun.rounds, C.gun.pocket] }; window.__tries.push(rec); } if (C.failing) { if (!rec.why) { const f = (C.log || []).filter((e) => e[1] === 'FAIL').pop(); if (f) { rec.why = f[2]; rec.t = f[0]; } } return; } if (C.kit.warning === "He's nearly at the pier." && rec.gateAt == null) rec.gateAt = +C.t.toFixed(1); }, 50); return JSON.stringify(window.__pk); })()

steps.label: the gun phase: the cylinder and six in the pocket (POCKET.tail)

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ tries: window.__tries, fails: (window.__tailFails || []).map((f) => f.why + '@' + f.t) })
